== Classification

Release note only. No product documentation page change was identified.

Reviewed against the existing passcode content in `device-lab-management` (iOS and Android device
preparation) and in past release notes. Those pages describe how to request passcode mode and how to
clear a device passcode before connecting a device. None of them document the first-connection
behavior or the reconnect workaround, so no existing page becomes inaccurate as a result of this fix
and no new page is required.

== Target release

Not determined. The change had not merged or shipped when this draft was written, so no version
number and no release date are asserted here. Confirm the target release before publishing.

== Draft entry

Place under `== Improvements and fixes`. Area subsections on recent release pages are alphabetical,
which puts *Device passcode* after *Device management* and before *MCP and integrations*.

[source,asciidoc]
----
=== Device passcode

- Fixed an issue where a device connecting for the first time in a passcode-enabled organization came online without its passcode. The passcode is now applied on that first connection. You no longer need to disconnect and reconnect the device or restart deviceConnect services to apply it.
----

== Review notes

* Applies only to organizations with passcode mode enabled. Organizations with passcode mode off are
unaffected.
* Existing devices keep their current behavior. A per-device passcode opt-out and the Android version
exclusion are still honored.
* Deliberately left out of the entry: diagnostic logging added alongside the fix. It is internal and
not user-visible.
* Wording follows the phrasing already used in published notes, for example "for passcode-enabled
organizations only" in 4.18.3, and links the workaround to the existing
`deviceConnect/restart-deviceconnect-services.adoc` vocabulary.
